text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cabinet looks into possibility of bringing to Turkey the military command centre for Western no-fly zone over northern Iraq. The centre was previously based in northern Iraq.
- Court issues warrant for senior policeman accused of torturing suspects.
- Series of protest meetings to take place against economic policies of Islamist-led government.
- Baghdad-backed Iraqi Kurdish leader Massoud Barzani secretly sent his brother to Ankara last week to ask for help against Turkish Kurd group in northern Iraq.
- Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller and the U.S. ambassador agree on opening a camp in Turkey to shelter Iraqi Kurds who had worked for Washington in northern Iraq.
- Islamist-led government to announce a second economic package on Monday.
- Northern Iraq's Turkmens ask Turkey to protect them against President Saddam Hussein.
- United States may respond militarily to the two Iraqi anti-aircraft missiles fired on U.S. jets.
